visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two larger flare rings with four spikes each on the top-left/bottom-right diagonal, and two small plus sparkles tucked into the other corners; point-symmetric, as in the reference. A first candidate with r4 rings and centred pluses passed but was nearly identical to the rejected drawing (equal-weight blobs).
omissions: The reference's two tiny stray dots are dropped (sub-stroke at 48px).
drawing_plan: Flares r5 at (15,15)/(33,33) with spikes to 9 from centre; pluses arms 4 at (37,11)/(11,37).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'sparkles'/'sun': rings with straight rays and plus glints.
